lola-smallwood-cuevas.text: Smallwood-Cuevas voted Aye on AB 144 (health budget trailer), Senate floor, 9/12/2025.
Candidate profile: supports a Medicare for All model, expanding community health clinics, and opposes corporate takeovers of public hospitals.
Candidate profile: champion of keeping California a safe haven for people seeking reproductive healthcare and abortion services.
Candidate profile: advocates carbon neutrality goals and environmental justice; supports Project Roomkey model and building affordable housing as job creation.
Candidate profile: favors enforcing labor laws, investing in apprenticeships, and corporate tax accountability, while reducing regulatory burden on small businesses.

joe-lisuzzo.text: Wants to "Increase Public Safety funding support the rule of law for ALL the People of California" and target waste and fraud.
Supports business-friendly policy: cutting business taxes and reducing regulatory red tape.
Proposes a gas tax holiday until California prices match national averages and inviting refineries back to California to reduce fuel imports.
Calls LA school underperformance "a management problem" despite about $19 billion annual LAUSD funding; calls for reform and alternative educational opportunities.
Calls homelessness a "Humanitarian Crisis" and questions how $24 billion in voter-approved funding has been allocated.

notes: Smallwood-Cuevas: BallotReady profile text may predate 2026. Her Senate page gave no policy detail.
